summary: LightPath Technologies filed an 8-K announcing the October 30, 2026 closing of the previously announced sale of 100% of its wholly owned Chinese subsidiary, LightPath (Zhenjiang) Optical Instrumentation Co., Ltd. (LPOIZ), including its manufacturing facility, to an entity owned by LPOIZ's incumbent management team. No purchase price, premium, or advisor was disclosed in the excerpt. Post-closing, LightPath has no China-based facilities or operations, reinforcing its NDAA-compliant, Western-aligned manufacturing footprint across the U.S. and Europe. LPOIZ will continue supplying LightPath as a third-party vendor for continuity; China third-party revenue averaged roughly $4.5 million annually across fiscal 2025-2026 and drops out of consolidated results. Watch supply-continuity and revenue-dis-synergy risk on the now-smaller base.
